answer: The lagoon counter is kept in crystal and vault shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An hostile operator as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 69 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
